teaser: The community garden plot with the latch that never quite closes is where life path 6 meets ENTP most plainly: the one who feels the uneven hinge as a small personal failure, and the one who wants to rebuild the whole fence line instead of just the latch. The devotion is real; so is the itch to redesign the thing being devoted to. ENTP argues for the better system, 6 insists the old one just needs tending, and both of those live in the one person standing at the gate holding a screwdriver and a different idea than the one they started with.
